summary: Wooden Conservation Commission lookout built May 1911 on Dun Brook Mountain, Hamilton County; unstaffed 1913-14, abandoned 1919 or 1920; gone, and no source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Built 1911 and the 1920 end of fire watching are from Wikipedia; the 1913-14 unstaffed notes and the 1919 abandonment are from the Eastern lookouts site; CNY Hiking's REMOVED in 1919 matches the Eastern date. The end year is disputed (1919 vs 1920) and the story reports both. No source describes what remains on the mountain or who controls access, so access and trail keys are left unset. Spelling: Dun Brook (Wikipedia, Eastern site) vs Dunn Brook (FFLA list and the record). Coordinates differ between the record (FFLA, 43.89786, -74.32272) and the Eastern site (43.8909, -74.31877); not settled here. Elevation differs between Wikipedia (3,563 ft) and CNY Hiking (3605 ft); not used. A Facebook group post in search results asks about routes to former tower sites here; not used because it is a question, not a source. No photos found.
